sql: SELECT strftime(first_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS first, strftime(last_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS last FROM corpus_stats WHERE dataset = $1

WITH matched AS (SELECT log_events.event_id, log_events.ts, log_events.pattern_id FROM log_events WHERE log_events.dataset = $1 AND log_events.ts >= $2::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.ts < $3::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.pattern_id = $4), anchors AS (SELECT event_id, ts FROM matched MATCH_RECOGNIZE (ORDER BY ts, event_id MEASURES FIRST(event_id) AS event_id, FIRST(ts) AS ts ONE ROW PER MATCH AFTER MATCH SKIP PAST LAST ROW PATTERN (s n*) DEFINE n AS ts - PREV(ts) < $5::INTERVAL)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM matched) AS matched_events, (SELECT count(*) FROM anchors) AS anchors, (SELECT count(DISTINCT pattern_id) FROM matched) AS excluded_patterns, (epoch_us($6::TIMESTAMPTZ) - epoch_us($7::TIMESTAMPTZ) + $8::BIGINT - 1) // $9::BIGINT AS grid_windows

WITH matched AS (SELECT log_events.event_id, log_events.ts, log_events.pattern_id FROM log_events WHERE log_events.dataset = $1 AND log_events.ts >= $2::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.ts < $3::TIMESTAMPTZ AND log_events.pattern_id = $4), anchors AS (SELECT event_id, ts FROM matched MATCH_RECOGNIZE (ORDER BY ts, event_id MEASURES FIRST(event_id) AS event_id, FIRST(ts) AS ts ONE ROW PER MATCH AFTER MATCH SKIP PAST LAST ROW PATTERN (s n*) DEFINE n AS ts - PREV(ts) < $5::INTERVAL)), excluded AS (SELECT DISTINCT pattern_id FROM matched WHERE pattern_id IS NOT NULL), hits AS (SELECT 'before' AS direction, e.pattern_id, count(DISTINCT a.event_id) AS anchors_with_pattern, min(e.event_id) AS example_event_id FROM anchors a JOIN log_events e ON e.dataset = $6 AND e.ts >= a.ts - $7::INTERVAL AND e.ts < a.ts WHERE e.pattern_id NOT IN (SELECT pattern_id FROM excluded) GROUP BY e.pattern_id), ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY direction ORDER BY anchors_with_pattern DESC, pattern_id) AS rank, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY direction) AS patterns_found FROM hits), top AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rank <= $8::BIGINT), info AS (SELECT e.dataset, e.pattern_id, any_value(e.component) AS component, any_value(e.pattern) AS pattern FROM log_events e WHERE e.dataset = $6 AND e.pattern_id IN (SELECT pattern_id FROM top) GROUP BY e.dataset, e.pattern_id), n AS (SELECT count(*) AS anchors FROM anchors), grid AS (SELECT e.pattern_id, count(DISTINCT (epoch_us(e.ts) - epoch_us($9::TIMESTAMPTZ)) // $11::BIGINT) AS windows_with_pattern FROM log_events e WHERE e.dataset = $6 AND e.ts >= $9::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.ts < $10::TIMESTAMPTZ AND e.pattern_id IN (SELECT pattern_id FROM top) GROUP BY e.pattern_id), grid_size AS (SELECT (epoch_us($12::TIMESTAMPTZ) - epoch_us($13::TIMESTAMPTZ) + $14::BIGINT - 1) // $15::BIGINT AS windows) SELECT t.direction, t.patterns_found, t.pattern_id, left(i.pattern, 400) AS pattern, length(i.pattern) > 400 AS pattern_truncated, i.component, coalesce((SELECT o.team FROM ownership o WHERE o.dataset = i.dataset AND o.component = i.component), 'unowned') AS team, t.anchors_with_pattern, t.anchors_with_pattern / n.anchors::DOUBLE AS anchor_share, coalesce(g.windows_with_pattern, 0) AS base_rate_windows, coalesce(g.windows_with_pattern, 0) / gs.windows::DOUBLE AS base_rate, CASE WHEN g.windows_with_pattern > 0 THEN (t.anchors_with_pattern / n.anchors::DOUBLE) / (g.windows_with_pattern / gs.windows::DOUBLE) END AS ratio, t.example_event_id FROM top t JOIN info i ON i.pattern_id = t.pattern_id CROSS JOIN n CROSS JOIN grid_size gs LEFT JOIN grid g ON g.pattern_id = t.pattern_id ORDER BY CASE t.direction WHEN 'before' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.rank
